κωφός.sd: blunted, i.e. (figuratively) of hearing (deaf) or speech (dumb)
κωφός.as:
κωφός, -ή, -όν
(< κόπτω), [in LXX chiefly (Ex 4:11, al.) for אִלֵּם; for חֵרֵשׁ, Hb 2:18;]
blunt, dull. Metaph., of the senses, esp.
(a) of speech, dumb: Mt 9:32, 3312:2215:30, 31, Lk 1:2211:14;
(b) of hearing, deaf: Mt 11:5, Mk 7:32, 379:25, Lk 7:22.†

κώμη.as:
κώμη, -ης, ἡ,
[in LXX for בַּת, חָצֵר, עִיר, etc.;]
a village or country town, prop, as opp. to a walled city: Mt 14:15, Mk 6:6, al.; πόλεις καὶ κ., Mt 9:35, al.; with the name added, Βηθλεέμ, Jo 7:42; Βηθανΐα, Jo 11:1; with the name of the district, τὰς κ. Καισαρίας, Mk 8:27; Σαμαρειτῶν, Lk 9:52, Ac 8:25.

κωλύω.long: I prevent, debar, hinder; with infin: from doing so and so.
κωλύω.sd: to estop, i.e. prevent (by word or act)
κωλύω.kj: forbid, hinder, keep from, let, not suffer, withstand
κωλύω.as:
κωλύω
(< κόλος), [in LXX for כּלא, מנע, etc.;]
to hinder, restrain, forbid, withhold: c. acc. et inf., Mt 19:14, Lk 23:2, Ac 8:3616:624:23, I Th 2:16, He 7:23; inf. om., Mk 9:38, 3910:14, Lk 9:49, 5011:5218:16, Ac 11:17, Ro 1:13, III Jo 10; acc. om., I Ti 4:3; c. acc. pers. et gen. rei, Ac 27:43; c. acc. rei, I Co 14:39, II Pe 2:16; id. seq. τοῦ μή, Ac 10:47; id. seq. ἀπό (like Heb. כָּלָאמִן, Ge 23:6, al.), Lk 6:29 (cf. δια-κωλύω).†

κώνωψ.long: a gnat, mosquito, referred to proverbially as something small.
κώνωψ.der: apparently a derivative of the base of G2759 (κέντρον) and a derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);

κωμόπολις.long: a large village, a city which in constitution has only the status of a village; a country town.
κωμόπολις.as:
*† κωμόπολις, -εως, ἡ,
a country town: Mk 1:38 (v. Swete, in l.).†

Κωσάμ.long: Cosam, son of Elmadam and father of Addi.

Κώς.long: Cos, an island in the Aegean Sea, south-west of Asia Minor.
Κώς.sd: Cos, an island in the Mediterranean
Κώς.as:
Κῶς, gen. Κῶ, ἡ,
Cos, an island in the Ægean Sea: acc. Κῶ, Ac 21:1 (Κῶν, Rec.).†

κῶμος.as:
** κῶμος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX: Wi 14:23, II Mac 6:4*;]
a revel, carousal: Ro 13:13, Ga 5:21, I Pe 4:3.†
SYN.: v.s. κραιπάλη.

κῶλον.long: a limb, member of a body; fig: a corpse, carcass.
κῶλον.sd: a limb of the body (as if lopped)
κῶλον.as:
κῶλον, -ου, τό,
a limb, member of a body, [but in LXX (Le 26:30, Nu 14:29, 32, 33, I Ki 17:46, Is 66:24*) for פֶּגֶר;] hence, carcase: He 3:17(LXX).†
